name: Editorial Rating – Product Review & Rating System
author: Pluginic

sections.description:
Source Code for Generated/Compressed Content

This plugin uses the following third-party libraries and generated/minified code:

  • Gutenberg Blocks (build/index.js): Source code available at https://github.com/pluginic/editorial-rating
  • Font Awesome 5.15.5: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome (Font Awesome Free License)
  • VenoBox 2.1.8: https://github.com/nicholasruunu/venobox (MIT License)
  • Splide 4.1.4: https://github.com/Splidejs/splide (MIT License)

Build tools used: npm and webpack for block compilation.

Plugin Description

Add product reviews effortlessly to your WordPress product posts or pages with Editorial Rating – a comprehensive product review plugin for WordPress.

Now you can add multi-criteria product rating & reviews for any WordPress post using Editorial Rating. It’s easy to install and has an advanced dashboard that works seamlessly with any WordPress website.

✨ Live Demo | 📚Documentation | 💬Support Forum » | 🌟Premium Features | 🔥Get Pro (30% OFF)»

By using this plugin, you can create multiple review criteria for your WordPress product posts or pages, including product quality, features, service aspects, price, pros, cons, and more. These multiple review criteria help users make wise decisions effortlessly. Additionally, users can rate products through comment reviews and visitor star ratings.

The free version allows you to set limited criteria for your product reviews. To add more criteria, you’ll need to upgrade to the premium version of Editorial Rating.

Watch The Official Video For Install, How To Install and Use Editorial Rating WordPress Product Review Plugin

Product Review System With Star Rating (WooCommerce Support)

A comprehensive WordPress product review solution that helps you add multi-criteria product rating, increase engagement, build loyalty, improve SEO, and get more sales with social proof.

Editorial Rating is a FREE WordPress product review plugin that enhances WordPress and eCommerce sites with a bundle of awesome features: Multi-criteria star Ratings, Total Score Calculation, Review Schema, Pros and Cons Highlights, and more. Amplify your website’s potential with expert Editorial Ratings and insightful Customer Reviews. Plus, you can enjoy the added flair of Pros and Cons showcases and eye-catching Rating Widgets to captivate your visitors.

Key Features Of Editorial Product Rating System

Have a quick scan at the core features you can get with this plugin:

  • Multi-Criteria Rating and Reviews on single posts/pages.
  • Shortcode System
  • 9+ Ready made Review Layout (For Free 1)
  • 7+ Cross / Compare Rating layout (Pro)
  • Customer Rating options (Pro)
  • Visitor Rating options (Pro)
  • Pros and Cons Option
  • Show/hide score on the post.
  • WooCommerce Compatibility (Pro)
  • Review Schema Support
  • Total Score calculation of each point / total rating category.
  • Editorial Rating on the sidebar.
  • Sticky Editorial Rating Sidebar.
  • Custom badge
  • Percentage Indicator
  • Professional design
  • Pros and Cons
  • SEO-optimized Schema Markup for Rich Snippets
  • Highly customizable rating layout
  • Rating Widgets
  • 5+ Chart Types (Pro)
  • 9+ Layouts (Pro)
  • WYSIWYG Content Editor (Pro)
  • Compare rating layout (Pro)
  • Compare Products (Pro)
  • Multiple Widgets (Pro)
  • Slider with Auto-rotation (Pro)
  • Woocommerce compatibility (Pro)
  • Multisite Supported
  • Cross-browser compatibility
  • Multi-language compatible
  • And much more!

Editorial Rating Shortcodes

  • [WPASER]
  • [WPASER id=”post_id”]

Why Our Editorial Rating is the Ultimate Product Review Plugin

Whether you’re starting a blog to review products, an e-commerce site, or a news portal, the Editorial Rating plugin is your all-in-one solution to deliver comprehensive, professional reviews. Here’s why it stands out:

1. Multi-Criteria Ratings System

Gone are the days of single-score reviews! With Editorial Rating, you can assess products or services based on multiple criteria such as quality, design, performance, price, and more. This allows your audience to get a detailed understanding of what you’re reviewing, leading to better-informed decisions.

2. Stunning Visual Appeal

First impressions matter, and Editorial Rating ensures your reviews look stunning. With over 9+ customizable review layouts, you can present your ratings in a way that aligns perfectly with your brand’s aesthetic. From sleek, minimalist designs to bold, vibrant layouts, the choice is yours.

3. Engage Your Audience with Pros & Cons

Every product has its highs and lows, and your audience deserves to know both sides. Editorial Rating makes it effortless to highlight the pros and cons of any product, helping readers quickly grasp its strengths and weaknesses at a glance.

4. Schema Markup for SEO

Want your reviews to stand out in search engine results? Editorial Rating integrates seamlessly with Review Schema Markup, enabling rich snippets that enhance your visibility on Google and other search engines. This not only boosts your SEO but also attracts more clicks and traffic to your site.

5. Customizable Review Widgets

Make your ratings visible anywhere on your site with customizable widgets. Whether it’s a sidebar, footer, or a dedicated review section, Editorial Rating gives you the flexibility to place your reviews where they matter most.

6. User-Friendly for Everyone

You don’t need to be a tech wizard to use Editorial Rating. Its intuitive interface and easy-to-use settings make it accessible for beginners, while advanced users will appreciate the depth of customization options available.

7. Cross-Platform Compatibility

Whether you’re using WordPress, WooCommerce, or any other platform, Editorial Rating integrates seamlessly. It’s compatible with most themes and plugins, ensuring a smooth experience across your entire site.

8. Boost Conversions with Trust

When your audience sees detailed, well-structured reviews, it builds trust. Editorial Rating helps you establish credibility, which translates into higher conversions, whether you’re driving affiliate sales, promoting your own products, or simply growing your readership.

9. Mobile-Responsive Design

In today’s mobile-first world, your reviews need to look perfect on every device. Editorial Rating is fully responsive, ensuring your reviews display flawlessly on desktops, tablets, and smartphones.

10. Lifetime Support & Updates

When you choose Editorial Rating, you’re not just getting a plugin—you’re gaining a partner. With dedicated support and regular updates, we ensure your review system stays ahead of the curve.

Editorial Rating Free vs Pro: What’s the Difference?

Free Version Highlights:

  • 1 Review Layout
  • Multi-Criteria Ratings
  • Pros & Cons Display
  • Review Schema Support
  • Basic Customization Options

Pro Version Benefits:

  • 9+ Premium Layouts
  • Advanced Customization (colors, fonts, etc.)
  • Compare Rating Layouts
  • WooCommerce Integration
  • Customer & Visitor Ratings
  • 5+ Chart Types
  • Priority Support
  • And much more!

Upgrade to Pro and unlock the full potential of Editorial Rating!

Who Can Benefit from Editorial Rating?

  • Bloggers & Reviewers: Create in-depth, professional reviews that captivate your audience.
  • E-Commerce Stores: Showcase product reviews with detailed ratings to boost sales and customer trust.
  • Affiliate Marketers: Highlight the features and benefits of products you’re promoting with ease.
  • News & Magazine Sites: Add credibility to your articles with structured, data-driven reviews.

No matter your niche, Editorial Rating is designed to elevate your content and engage your audience.

How to Get Started with Editorial Rating

Getting started is simple:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress repository.
2. Configure your rating criteria and design preferences.
3. Start adding reviews to your posts or pages.
4. Watch as your site transforms into a trusted review destination!

Take Your Reviews to the Next Level

With Editorial Rating, you’re not just adding reviews—you’re creating experiences. From detailed multi-criteria ratings to eye-catching layouts and SEO-optimized schema markup, this plugin is your ticket to standing out in a crowded digital landscape.

Ready to revolutionize the way you review products? Download Editorial Rating today and see the difference it can make!

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Easiest Way)

To do an automatic install of Editorial Rating, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New. In the search field type “Editorial Rating” and click Search Plugins. Once you have found it you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now” and then “Activate”.

Manual Installation

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download editorial-rating.zip
  2. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  3. Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  4. Select editorial-rating.zip from your computer
  5. Click ‘Install Now’
  6. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  1. Download editorial-rating.zip
  2. Extract the editorial-rating directory to your computer
  3. Upload the editorial-rating directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  4. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard
sections.faq:
How to use this plugin?

See the documentation: Editorial Rating Documentation

Can I add multiple review criteria?

Yes! You can add multiple review criteria to provide detailed ratings for different aspects of your product or service.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes, the Pro version includes full WooCommerce integration.

Is this plugin SEO-friendly?

Absolutely! Editorial Rating includes Review Schema Markup support, which helps your reviews appear as rich snippets in search results.

Can visitors rate products?

Yes, with the Pro version, you can enable visitor and customer ratings.

Is the plugin mobile-responsive?

Yes, all layouts are fully responsive and work perfectly on all devices.

Can I customize the review layout?

Yes! The plugin offers multiple customization options for colors, fonts, and layouts. The Pro version provides even more advanced customization features.

Does it work with my theme?

Editorial Rating is designed to work with any well-coded WordPress theme.

Where can I get support?

You can get support by visiting our Support Forum.
